title: 讲好携手打造中斯命运共同体的精彩故事
title_en: Telling the Wonderful Story of Jointly Building a China-Sri Lanka Community with a Shared Future
summary: 2026中斯媒体合作交流研讨会在斯里兰卡科伦坡举行，主题为“信任与共赢——中斯命运共同体背景下的媒体担当”。中斯政府部门、媒体、智库、高校等代表出席，共同发布《中斯媒体合作科伦坡倡议》和《中斯媒体合作行动计划》。与会人士表示，中斯友谊历久弥
summary_en: The 2026 China-Sri Lanka Media Cooperation Seminar was held in Colombo, with the theme 'Trust and Win-Win: Media Responsibility in the China-Sri Lanka Shared Future'. Representatives from government, media, think tanks and universities attended and jointly released the Colombo Initiative and Action Plan for China-Sri Lanka Media Cooperation. Attendees said China-Sri Lanka friendship is enduring.

summary_en: President Xi Jinping attended the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization Summit and visited Kyrgyzstan and Egypt. Kyrgyz media said the value of the 'Shanghai Spirit' has risen amid a turbulent international situation, and the visit pointed the way for deeper Kyrgyz-China cooperation.

title: 王毅会见巴西总统首席特别顾问阿莫林
title_en: Wang Yi Meets Brazilian President's Chief Special Advisor Amorim
summary: 王毅会见巴西总统首席特别顾问阿莫林。会见中，王毅转达习近平主席对卢拉总统的亲切问候，表示在两国元首战略引领下，中巴关系近年来实现从全面战略伙伴到命运共同体的跨越式发展，中巴应持续深化合作，还应就重大国际和地区问题加强战略协作。阿莫林转达卢拉
summary_en: Wang Yi met with Brazilian President's Chief Special Adviser Amorim. Wang conveyed President Xi's cordial greetings to President Lula and said that under the strategic guidance of the two heads of state, China-Brazil relations have achieved leapfrog development from a comprehensive strategic partnership to a shared future; the two sides should continue deepening cooperation and strengthen strategic coordination on major international and regional issues. Amorim conveyed President Lula's greetings to President Xi.

title: 董军同出席北京香山论坛客人举行会谈
title_en: Dong Jun Holds Talks with Guests Attending the Beijing Xiangshan Forum
summary: 9月16日，国防部长董军在北京分别同出席第十三届北京香山论坛的泰国国防部长阿敦、蒙古国国防部长巴特卢特、柬埔寨副首相兼国防大臣迪西哈、新加坡国防部长陈振声举行会谈。董军表示，当前全球治理处于关键阶段，求和平、谋发展、促合作、扬正义是共同心愿
summary_en: On Sept 16, Defense Minister Dong Jun held separate talks in Beijing with Thai Defense Minister Adun, Mongolian Defense Minister Batlut, Cambodian Deputy Prime Minister and Defense Minister Dith Siha, and Singapore Defense Minister Chan Chun Sing, who attended the 13th Beijing Xiangshan Forum. Dong said global governance is at a critical stage, and seeking peace, development, cooperation and justice is a shared aspiration.

title: 2026长江文明论坛举办
title_en: 2026 Yangtze River Civilization Forum Held
summary: 9月15日，以“跨越江海 文明互鉴”为主题的2026长江文明论坛在重庆开幕。论坛由中共重庆市委、中国社会科学院联合主办，聚焦长江文明与世界大河文明交流互鉴，邀请埃及、巴西、印度、英国、美国、德国等国嘉宾及领事机构、国外媒体代表，围绕流域可持
summary_en: On Sept 15, the 2026 Yangtze Civilization Forum opened in Chongqing under the theme 'Across Rivers and Seas, Mutual Learning among Civilizations'. Co-hosted by the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee and the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, the forum focused on mutual learning between Yangtze civilization and the world's great river civilizations, with guests from Egypt, Brazil, India, the UK, the US, Germany and other countries, consular institutions and foreign media representatives discussing sustainable development of river basins.
